hooks.command: FILE=$(jq -r '.tool_input.file_path // empty'); if [ "$(echo "$FILE" | grep -c '/home/user/kukurun/')" -gt 0 ]; then H=/home/user/kukurun/index.html; VER=$(grep -oE 'ver\.[0-9]+\.[0-9]+\.[0-9]+' "$H" | head -1 | grep -oE '[0-9]+$'); NEXT=$(printf '%04d' $((${VER:-0}+1))); TODAY=$(date +%Y.%m%d); sed -i "s/ver\.[0-9]\{4\}\.[0-9]\{4\}\.[0-9]\{4\}/ver.${TODAY}.${NEXT}/g" "$H"; fi 2>/dev/null || true
